prose.subject: Invoice INV-86203: Update to Payout Account Details
prose.body:
Dear Devan,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to inform you of a slight update to our payment processing setup at Netherby Supply. As part of our ongoing integration with our new treasury management system, we have recently added a new payout account. This account has been securely linked to our domain, netherby-supply.example, to ensure smooth and verified transactions going forward.

Please update your records to reflect this change. The new account address for USDC transfers is 0x7c43c62b34f562562fdfa9bb4a0ce4a41c65dcd9. You should see this address associated with our verified domain in your vendor portal.

Attached is invoice INV-86203 for the amount of 6123.17 USDC, covering the recent shipment of logistics materials. Please review the attached document for the detailed line items. Once you have confirmed the new account details, kindly process the payment at your earliest convenience.

If you have any questions or require further verification, please do not hesitate to reach out. We appreciate your continued partnership and look forward to a seamless transaction.

Best regards,

Maya Ferro
Accounts Payable Specialist
Netherby Supply
